items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets: outperform rating, price target cut to $157 from $166. Demand growth outpacing supply despite Q2 lithium price softness; robust stationary storage demand from US auto OEMs.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist keeps Buy rating; cites cost efficiencies, capital discipline, resilient lithium demand and constrained supply as supportive of valuation despite recent pullback.
